paper_title: RLHF Workflow From Reward Modeling to Online RLHF
caption: The training record of preference modeling. From the left to right, we present the records of training loss, gradient norm, and the learning rate, respectively.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the training loss of a preference model over the course of training, with the x-axis representing the training step ranging from 0 to approximately 1300 in linear scale and the y-axis representing the training loss ranging from 0 to 14, also in linear scale. A single solid blue line with no markers traces the loss trajectory: it begins at approximately 13.5 at step 0, drops sharply to below 1 by step 50, then continues to decline gradually to near 0.1 by step 200, and remains nearly flat and close to zero for the remainder of the training steps up to 1300. The legend identifies this line as “Training Loss of Preference Model.” The plot includes a grid for easier reading of values.
